source.title: 30 Min FULL BODY WORKOUT with WARM UP | No Equipment & No Repeat | Rowan Row

notes: Checked against the video: names and timer read at the start and end of the moves, and around every longer rest. A warm-up of eleven 30 s moves and one of 26 s from 64 s, then four blocks of six 40 s moves with 20 s rests; a 40 s rest before the first block and between the blocks. The label is a small NOW: <move> top left beside a ring timer (green work, red rest), so the name is on screen throughout. 0-64 s intro and the outro after 1940 s are null.

timeline: 3 x Push Up 3 x Mtn Climbers
Reg Push Up Into Plank Rotation
